purpose: Prove that the M10W24B parent coverage_class=NEITHER cohort can be reproduced at each decision using only information available by that decision, before freezing any MMO1 fresh prospective start.
why_required: M10W14 historical LONG coverage first calls replay_m7c(), which only appends a primary episode after its exit is observed, and then finds the first-turn retrospectively inside that completed episode. The first-turn rule and branch filters are causal, but directly reusing the completed-pair historical implementation in a fresh runtime would delay presence until a future episode exit. M10W25 replaces only the materialization mechanism with a chronological prefix state machine and compares it to the frozen historical coverage map without reading outcomes.

sources.frozen_gold_bars: Exact M10A frozen 2023-2026 M1/M5/M15/H1/H4/D1 files and SHA256 contract.

prefix_causal_long_reproduction.primary_state_machine: Exact M10A replay_m7c RCI9/EMA20/30/40 transition rules processed chronologically at each timeframe next-bar open, without requiring a future exit to materialize an active episode.
prefix_causal_long_reproduction.first_turn: Exact M10W14 first-turn condition. At decision t use only already observed M1 bars; a raw first-turn is consumed once per active LONG primary episode exactly as the historical break-after-first-turn rule.
prefix_causal_long_reproduction.same_timestamp_exit_precedence: If a primary exit transition occurs at the same timestamp as a potential first-turn materialization, apply the exit first so no turn is emitted at or after the historical exit boundary.
prefix_causal_long_reproduction.branch_filters: Apply the exact frozen M5_S1/M15_S2/H1_S3/H4_S4 branch filters using selected fully closed source bars and their trailing quantiles only.

prefix_causal_short_reproduction: Use exact frozen M10W13 M10P C056+G013 and M10P2 C0212 decision formulas. Their source bars are already fully closed by decision and no future exit/outcome is used.
required_outputs: full causal coverage grid using the six frozen family-presence definitions
per-family historical-vs-causal presence mismatch counts over all M10W14 grid rows
coverage_class mismatch rows over all grid rows
HIGH-ATR bullish target family-presence and coverage-class mismatch counts
exact symmetric difference between causal target NEITHER decisions and M10W24B corrected pre-entry feature decision set
audit proving no outcome file, future return, future episode exit or future path label was used

decision_rule.PASS_FOR_MMO1_FRESH_DESIGN: All 8648 target-regime rows are present, historical target NEITHER count is 5917, target per-family presence mismatch count is 0, target coverage_class mismatch count is 0, and causal target NEITHER decision set exactly equals the 5917 M10W24B pre-entry feature decisions.
decision_rule.MISMATCH: Any target family-presence mismatch, target coverage-class mismatch, target-count mismatch, or target-NEITHER decision-set symmetric difference >0.
decision_rule.full_grid_mismatch_outside_target: Report descriptively. It does not authorize changing the MMO1 target scope or any frozen family. If target parity is exact, unrelated outside-target mismatches do not by themselves block an MMO1-only fresh design, but must remain documented.
decision_rule.on_pass: M10W26 may freeze a brand-new MMO1 fresh prospective shadow design. It still must initialize from a new stable live M1 frontier and cannot use pre-start history as prospective evidence.
decision_rule.on_mismatch: Do not read outcomes and do not tune. M10W26 fresh start is forbidden. Freeze a separate causal-cohort correction contract before any performance re-evaluation.
